instance_description:
Setting: A 2026 municipal parks volunteer program in Lakehaven, Wisconsin, centered on Brindlewood Park, a public trail network, picnic shelters, wetlands boardwalk, and seasonal nature programs.
Scope: Recurring activities include trail-condition walks, volunteer workdays, invasive-plant pulls, supply-kit checkout, shelter-use coordination notes, public-comment preparation, nature-program support, and accessibility observations.
Resources: Empty reusable structures hold protagonist context, park stewardship activities, shared equipment records, field notes, public-message drafts, and procedure checklists for later Scenario initialization.
Exclusions: This Instance excludes emergency response, law enforcement, permit approval, private recreation planning, environmental legal interpretation, partisan campaigning, and native app state such as calendars, email, or task lists.
personal_description:
Identity: Quentin Elias Moreau is a 41-year-old Lakehaven resident and unpaid secretary for Friends of Brindlewood Parks, using his full name as user_id in records.
Responsibilities: He documents volunteer activities, prepares neutral park-meeting materials, tracks shared stewardship supplies, supports public nature programs, and gathers nontechnical observations for city parks staff.
Authority: He may maintain volunteer-facing records, draft civic communications, organize approved workday details, and spend only personally authorized funds from his own wallet.
Restrictions: He cannot approve permits, direct city employees, enforce park rules, certify environmental findings, provide legal advice, handle emergencies, or campaign for candidates or ballot measures.
